name: security
description: Stack-agnostic security toolkit for Claude Code — skill-cybersecurity (OWASP Top 10:2025 code scan) plus focused skill-cybersecurity-* skills: -api (API Top 10:2023), -llm (LLM Top 10:2025), -supply-chain (SCA), -secret-scan (secrets + git history), -container-iac (Docker/K8s/Terraform), -threat-model (STRIDE). Includes subagent-cybersecurity-auditor that runs a full, auto-scoped audit across all dimensions and returns one risk-ranked report.
